summary: Frontend-only E2E test of the Featured Offers redesign (CashGPT, TanStack Start on port 3000 preview URL) using the QA login qa.assistant@cashgpt.test. PRIMARY BUG IS FIXED: after login, /home, /offers and /featured all render data-testid='featured-offers-list' with cards (3 / 3 / 21 respectively) and the 'No offers available right now' empty state never appears. Loading skeleton (featured-offers-loading) was observed on first load of all three routes. On /featured 18 of 21 cards render real banners (network icon URLs from banners.hangmyads.com and cdn.affise.com, all with naturalWidth>0, i.e. successfully loaded, no broken-image); the 3 manual offers show the Gift icon on the jade gradient. No 'In review'/'Approved'/'Rejected' text found anywhere in the list on any route, and 0 buttons with text 'Claim' inside cards. Every card keeps data-testid='featured-offer-' and the corner chevron carries data-testid='featured-offer-claim-'. offer-tag-row pills render (3/3 on home, 17/21 on featured, overlaid on the banner). Clicking a manual card, clicking a network (image) card, and keyboard Enter on a focused card all open data-testid='offer-details-dialog' with title, gold payout ($4.50) and footer CTA 'I Understand, Continue' (offer-details-continue); offer-details-cancel closes it. Dialog panel is fully opaque once the open animation settles.

critical.issue: 500 {"code":"42P17","message":"infinite recursion detected in policy for relation \"offers\""} — an RLS policy on offers is self-referential. Featured Offers is unaffected (server fn uses service role), but any client-side offers query fails.

minor.issue: 400 {"code":"42703","message":"column user_tasks.target does not exist"} — client selects a non-existent column, so that widget's data silently fails (same class of bug as the fixed offers.image_url one).

integration_issues.flow: Home page card click (first visit / new user)
integration_issues.issue: The OnboardingTour overlay (data-testid='tour-overlay', z-[200], full-screen masked rect) covers the Featured Offers grid and intercepts pointer events, so cards are not clickable until the tour is skipped/completed. Real UX impact is expected-by-design (tour), but note automation must dismiss it; consider making the mask pointer-events-none outside the tooltip.

issues: 3-col grid at 390px makes title/description heavily truncated ('Coin Master...', 'CTConnect ...') — many network offers are indistinguishable because the first ~10 chars are identical; consider showing more title or a 2-col layout on small screens.
Two tag pills (HOT + EASY) stack on the banner top-left and partially cover the image/placeholder icon on the small cards.

action_items: Fix the recursive RLS policy on public.offers (42P17) so client-side offers queries stop returning 500.
Fix the client query selecting user_tasks.target (column does not exist) — align select list with actual schema.
Optional polish: card title truncation at 3-col/390px, and tag pills overlapping the banner artwork.
critical_code_review_comments: feed-cache.server.ts: imageUrlFromIcon() correctly derives image_url from the existing icon column; the fix is sound. Consider adding a real image_url column migration later so icon keywords and banner URLs are not overloaded in one field.

FeaturedOffers.tsx still imports/keeps the claimOffer mutation and toast wiring inside the card component; fine functionally, but the residual `pending`/mutation logic makes the component do two jobs — no Claim button exists so the naming data-testid='featured-offer-claim-<id>' on a pure chevron affordance is now misleading.
assembleFeaturedImpl casts rows with `as never` in several upserts, which disables type checking of the offers schema — this is exactly how the nonexistent-column bug slipped in.

success_rate.frontend: 100% of the 6 requested Featured Offers acceptance checks passed

context_for_next_testing_agent: Login at /auth (auth-email-input/auth-password-input/auth-submit-btn), wait for splash-screen to detach, THEN dismiss the OnboardingTour by clicking text 'Skip' (tour-overlay blocks all clicks). /home + /offers show 3 featured cards (manual offers, Gift placeholder), /featured shows 21 including 18 network cards with real images. Approved-claim auto-hide behavior was NOT verified (no approved offer_claims row available), as instructed.
rca_of_the_issue: Original 'No offers available' bug: the feed select listed offers.image_url which does not exist, so PostgREST errored the whole query and the feed returned []. Fix (deriving image_url from the icon column when it is an http(s) URL) is confirmed working in the browser — network banners load with naturalWidth>0 and manual offers fall back to the Gift icon. A related, still-open instance of the same pattern exists client-side: user_tasks.target (400) and a recursive offers RLS policy (500).
